entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help me. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with this whole experience.
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, it's just... not what I thought it would be. And honestly, I tried to return it weeks ago, but your website was broken. I really needed this money back, and I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time.
I certainly want to look into that for you. You mentioned there was a website error when you tried to start the return? Can you remember the approximate date?
It was right after New Year's, a few days in. The whole page just said the system down. I even took a screenshot because I was so frustrated. I couldn't print the label or do anything at all.

I understand. Let me just check our system status for early January... and yes, I am seeing a note here about a known outage with our returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that. Let me pull up your order details. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 29 days ago.
Oh, has it really been that long? Time just flies. I was so worried I was too late because of the website problem. It's been a stressful month.

Please don't worry. I'm checking our official company policy right now, and it states that items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only at 29 days, you're unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for you immediately.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Charlie.

You are very welcome. I'm glad I could sort this out. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help today.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
